To provide dedicated IT support to employees at the Head Office, ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of day-to-day IT requirements. The role will be responsible for troubleshooting technical issues, maintaining IT documentation, and managing the company's IT asset inventory to support operational efficiency.
q: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
2–3 years of experience in corporate IT support or a similar IT helpdesk role.
Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and services.
Familiarity with IP telephony systems and networking fundamentals.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to support employees across different departments.
Ability to manage multiple support requests, prioritize tasks, and work independently.
r: li
Provide day-to-day technical support to employees, addressing hardware, software, network, and system-related issues.
li
Troubleshoot and resolve IT incidents and service requests in a timely and effective manner.
li
Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computers, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment.
li
Provide technical support for Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications.
li
Assist with the administration and troubleshooting of IP telephony systems.
li
Support basic network connectivity and troubleshoot network-related issues.
li
Maintain accurate IT documentation, including technical records, support logs, and user-related information.
li
Manage and maintain the IT asset inventory, ensuring accurate records of assigned equipment, availability, and allocation.
li
Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding from an IT perspective, including equipment preparation, account setup, and access coordination.
li
Escalate complex technical issues to the IT Manager or relevant technical teams when required.
li
Ensure IT equipment and systems are maintained properly and in accordance with company procedures.
li
Provide responsive and professional support to ensure minimal disruption to employees' daily operations.

d: Responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the fuel station, ensuring prompt, efficient, and courteous service to customers. This includes directing the work of assigned Forecourt Attendants, refueling vehicles, servicing with oil, water, and air, selling dry items, and performing other forecourt duties. The role also involves managing fuel replenishment in storage tanks, preparing inventory sheets, recording timesheets, and ensuring adequate storage availability. Additionally, the position is accountable for handling cash inventory, managing opening and closing cash procedures, and running the station effectively during assigned shifts in compliance with company standards.
